scope: Java field and constant declaration owners as field slots; pins of the Java declaration owners that already resolve; Unit 1 of #1666

reference.configuration: JavacTask.parse on in-memory sources named C.java (module-info.java for the module source), options -proc:none -Xlint:dangling-doc-comments --release 25; DocTrees.getDocComment and getDocCommentTree per class, method, variable and module tree; javac diagnostics retained
reference.evidence: Executed on 2026-11-24 for every source of the production oracles; the attachment of each documentation comment and each dangling-comment warning were compared with the expected owners
reference.qualification: Source attachment only. No javadoc run; publication is not claimed.

legacy_measurement.qualification: Each measured file holds exactly the bytes of one legacy oracle source: no CR and one final LF, so file normalization changes nothing.

known_differences: A field declaration with a missing semicolon has a syntax error in the pinned grammar and stays a pending owner; javac recovers and attaches both comments.
A declaration with an unnamed (_) declarator stays a pending owner as a whole; javac reports an error for the name and still attaches the comment to every declarator.
The local text of /** a */ is a; DocTrees.getDocComment returns the raw text with its trailing space.

A documentation comment that holds a raw \u escape has no text and an unresolved association, which lists the field slots of a resolvable declaration as candidates; javac translates the escape and attaches the comment.
For /****/ before class C, BCA preserves the lone interior star as text '*'; JDK 25.0.5 DocTrees returns empty text (gap analysis j45). Publication for non-package targets stays Unknown.
pending: Other Java text edges such as /** x **/ remain outside the units
